traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: The mind meets disruption and originality. Fast, unconventional, leap-of-insight thinking that resists linear order. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Scattered, jumpy thinking, nervous tension, and impatience with slow or conventional reasoning. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.meaning: Thinking and disruption reach full awareness and face each other: culmination, objectivity, fulfillment or confrontation.

business: Friction in this area. Strong for innovation, problem-solving, and tech; weak for routine detail and steady communication.
shadow: Scattered overthinking collides with instability for its own sake; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: A confrontation builds; the other side comes fully into view.
arcSeparating: The standoff resolves into balance or a split.
base: Unexpected information can overturn a plan faster than everyone involved can agree on what the new facts mean.

readerCopy.body: Unexpected information can overturn a plan faster than everyone involved can agree on what the new facts mean. When Mercury opposes Uranus, information and disruption face each other directly, bringing reversals, contradictory messages, and sudden changes of perspective. The first update can be important without being complete. Confirmed change becomes easier to act on once panic, speculation, and incomplete reporting are kept from joining the facts.
